column5: GROUP: Terminal interpreter, embedding: | - TI/embedding.rs:392-397: a component binding accepts a host adapter when no supply is recorded for the boundary. Reader's wrong program: a required slot with no recorded supply gets a host adapter instead of a checked provider.

GROUP: Terminal interpreter, embedding: | - TI/embedding.rs:2908-2914: a boundary with no checked `declaration` is classed as not compiler-owned, so it counts as a host import and `select_external_supply` can replace it.

GROUP: Terminal interpreter, embedding: | - TI/embedding.rs:2114-2128: layout validation passes with no layouts when no layout applications are recorded. 1783-1786: provider storage request with no resolver answers `Ok(None)`. 1920-1930: binary search assumes sorted catalogs.

GROUP: Terminal interpreter, calls and custody: | - TI/engine_calls.rs:634-658: `begin_no_normal_call` has no callee result check. 671, 1078-1081, 1748: scalar results are compared by scalar type only. 2899-2905: `execute_select_implementation` writes the table id into the result integer without a range check; reader's wrong program: a `u8` result and a table id above 255. 271-285, 363-376: parameters skipped by `continue` in byte-sequence and element-view binding. 1061: `completion_callee` returns `Ok(None)`. 1717-1726: the namespace test passes when the caller has none. 3081-3089: `EmptyRunRelease` advances with checks only in the callee. 3627-3650: port write forwards with no check of service or port here.

GROUP: Terminal interpreter, calls and custody: | - TI/engine_custody.rs:556-604: `require_owned_value_claims` returns `Ok` early when the path leaves inline storage. Reader's wrong program: an owned operand whose path crosses a reference is used without claims. 69, 97, 101-103: a store through a mutable-borrow parameter, element-view root or `Referent` path adds no restoration obligation. 1556: a claim on a non-affine root adds no frontier split. 2067-2076: a content-entry claim naming an input that is not a parameter is recorded with `place: None` rather than refused.

GROUP: Terminal interpreter, calls and custody: | - TI/engine_structural.rs:1322-1324: membership repair is skipped for aggregate-view windows. 1815-1845: a leaf copy tolerates a type difference under quotient adaptation (callee not read).

GROUP: Terminal interpreter, calls and custody: | - TI/engine_execution.rs:44: an atomic store or swap through a `SharedBorrow` parameter is accepted (only `WriteOnlyBorrow` is refused). 534: every operation kind not named in the preflight is accepted with no capability check. 479-483: compiler-owned boundaries are not demanded from the host. 2744-2755: an Rflags write whose operand is missing or not an unsigned integer is skipped and the operation advances; an oversized value becomes `u64::MAX`. 2810-2812: `AtomicFence` advances with no capability check and no effect, unlike the register fence at 2726-2737. 1932-1937, 1959-1966: for target-family and checked-provider returns a result may carry fewer qualifications than declared. 3826-3831: float format is not compared.

GROUP: Terminal interpreter, storage: | - TI/storage_bytes_and_views.rs:3009-3016, 3571-3576: a view with no recorded home matches any value with an empty path. Reader's wrong program: a different empty-path value paired with a home-less view. Subslice and the copy-on-write branch drop the home (3090-3097, 3117, 3826). 865-891: `Ok(None)` for non-matching shapes. 649-673: the last fallback takes the first call-stack place with the same identity, path and type. 1587-1594: mutation is not checked for a non-parameter element-view root. 4868-4872: an empty-view subslice skips the check that result projected qualifications come from the source. 4157-4158: the whole-representation branch skips `track_affine_result`.
